cards.name: Maestros Charm
cards.oracleText:
Choose one —
• Look at the top five cards of your library. Put one of those cards into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.
• Each opponent loses 3 life and you gain 3 life.
• Maestros Charm deals 5 damage to target creature or planeswalker.

cards.name: Battle Mastery
cards.oracleText:
Enchant creature
Enchanted creature has double strike. (It deals both first-strike and regular combat damage.)

cards.name: Baleful Mastery
cards.oracleText:
You may pay {1}{B} rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
If the {1}{B} cost was paid, an opponent draws a card.
Exile target creature or planeswalker.

cards.name: Biomantic Mastery
cards.oracleText: Draw a card for each creature target player controls, then draw a card for each creature another target player controls.

cards.name: Maestros Confluence
cards.oracleText:
Choose three. You may choose the same mode more than once.
• Return target monocolored instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
• Target creature gets -3/-3 until end of turn.
• Goad each creature target player controls. (Until your next turn, those creatures attack each combat if able and attack a player other than you if able.)

cards.name: Devastating Mastery
cards.oracleText:
You may pay {2}{W}{W} rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
If the {2}{W}{W} cost was paid, an opponent chooses up to two nonland permanents they control and returns them to their owner's hand.
Destroy all nonland permanents.

cards.name: Maestros Diabolist
cards.oracleText:
Deathtouch, haste
Whenever this creature attacks, if you don't control a Devil token, create a tapped and attacking 1/1 red Devil creature token with "When this token dies, it deals 1 damage to any target."

cards.name: Maestros Ascendancy
cards.oracleText: Once during each of your turns, you may cast an instant or sorcery spell from your graveyard by sacrificing a creature in addition to paying its other costs. If a spell cast this way would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead.

cards.name: Elemental Mastery
cards.oracleText:
Enchant creature
Enchanted creature has "{T}: Create X 1/1 red Elemental creature tokens with haste, where X is this creature's power. Exile them at the beginning of the next end step."

cards.name: Elder Mastery
cards.oracleText:
Enchant creature
Enchanted creature gets +3/+3 and has flying.
Whenever enchanted creature deals damage to a player, that player discards two cards.

cards.name: Fervent Mastery
cards.oracleText:
You may pay {2}{R}{R} rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
If the {2}{R}{R} cost was paid, an opponent discards any number of cards, then draws that many cards.
Search your library for up to three cards, put them into your hand, shuffle, then discard three cards at random.

cards.name: Hunter's Prowess
cards.oracleText: Until end of turn, target creature gets +3/+3 and gains trample and "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, draw that many cards."

cards.name: Ingenious Mastery
cards.oracleText:
You may pay {2}{U} rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
If the {2}{U} cost was paid, you draw three cards, then an opponent creates two Treasure tokens and they scry 2. If that cost wasn't paid, you draw X cards.

cards.name: Maestros Initiate
cards.oracleText: {4}{U/R}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Draw two cards, then discard a card.

cards.name: Inspired Skypainter // Maestro's Gift
cards.oracleText:
Flying
When this creature enters and whenever one or more creature tokens you control deal combat damage to a player, this creature becomes prepared. (While it's prepared, you may cast a copy of its spell. Doing so unprepares it.)
Create a token that's a copy of target creature you control. That token gains haste until end of turn.

cards.name: Lich's Mastery
cards.oracleText:
Hexproof
You can't lose the game.
Whenever you gain life, draw that many cards.
Whenever you lose life, for each 1 life you lost, exile a permanent you control or a card from your hand or graveyard.
When Lich's Mastery leaves the battlefield, you lose the game.

cards.name: Liliana's Mastery
cards.oracleText:
Zombies you control get +1/+1.
When this enchantment enters, create two 2/2 black Zombie creature tokens.

cards.name: Lightning Prowess
cards.oracleText:
Enchant creature
Enchanted creature has haste and "{T}: This creature deals 1 damage to any target."

cards.name: Mizzix's Mastery
cards.oracleText:
Exile target card that's an instant or sorcery from your graveyard. For each card exiled this way, copy it, and you may cast the copy without paying its mana cost. Exile Mizzix's Mastery.
Overload {5}{R}{R}{R} (You may cast this spell for its overload cost. If you do, change "target" in its text to "each.")

cards.name: Temporal Mastery
cards.oracleText:
Take an extra turn after this one. Exile Temporal Mastery.
Miracle {1}{U} (You may cast this card for its miracle cost when you draw it if it's the first card you drew this turn.)

cards.name: Verdant Mastery
cards.oracleText:
You may pay {3}{G} rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
Search your library for up to four basic land cards and reveal them. Put one of them onto the battlefield tapped under an opponent's control if the {3}{G} cost was paid. Put two of them onto the battlefield tapped under your control and the rest into your hand. Then shuffle.

cards.name: Maestros Theater
cards.oracleText: When this land enters, sacrifice it. When you do, search your library for a basic Island, Swamp, or Mountain card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle and you gain 1 life.

cards.name: Maester Seymour
cards.oracleText:
At the beginning of combat on your turn, put a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Maester Seymour's power on another target creature you control.
{3}{G}{G}: Monstrosity X, where X is the number of counters among creatures you control. (If this creature isn't monstrous, put X +1/+1 counters on it and it becomes monstrous.)

cards.name: Metallic Mastery
cards.oracleText: Gain control of target artifact until end of turn. Untap that artifact. It gains haste until end of turn.

cards.name: Maestros' Totally Safe Hideout
cards.oracleText:
Land casualty 2 (As this land enters, you may sacrifice a creature with power 2 or greater. If you do, create a token that's a copy of this land.)
Maestros' Totally Safe Hideout enters the battlefield tapped.
{T}: Add {U}, {B}, or {R}.
